svg.aria-label: Ordered parallel encoding: credits bound the batches in flight, a reorder buffer restores production order
svg.title: Ordered parallel encoding: credits bound the batches in flight, a reorder buffer restores production order
svg.text: the writer returns a batch's credit when it takes the batch, in order
the grouper takes one credit per batch

g.text: the grouper takes a credit for each batch it hands out: #0…#3
all four credits are out: the grouper holds #4 back
#1, #2 and #3 finish first and wait for #0 in the reorder buffer
#0 arrives: the writer takes #0…#3 in order and returns their credits
each returned credit lets the grouper hand out one more batch
however slow one batch is, at most four batches are in flight
